claims.text: Hib, and to a lesser extent meningococcal and pneumococcal vaccines, have ↓bact meningitis incidence.
claims.quote: Use of vaccines for H. influenzae type B and, to a lesser extent, for N. meningitidis and S. pneumoniae has reduced the incidence of bacterial meningitis.

claims.text: MenB: 2-dose series for healthy 16–23 yr olds (shared decision-making).
claims.quote: ACIP recommends serogroup B meningococcal vaccine (MenB) as a 2-dose series for healthy persons aged 16–23 years based on shared clinical decision-making
claims.locator: Use of the GSK MenACWY-CRM/MenB-4C Pentavalent Meningococcal Vaccine Among Persons Aged ≥10 Years: Recommendations of the ACIP. MMWR Morb Mortal Wkly Rep 2026;75(1)

claims.text: MenACWY-CRM/MenB-4C (pentavalent) may be used when MenACWY and MenB are both due @ the same visit.
claims.quote: On April 16, 2025, ACIP recommended that MenACWY-CRM/MenB-4C may be used when both MenACWY and MenB are indicated at the same visit
